newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks trade in line with close.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks trade in line with close.

text.p: Stocks remained near their closing prices in after hours trading on Monday, dealers said, with Comcast Corp down a sliver from a 21-7/16 close, to 21-5/16, after Moody's Investors Service said it may raise the company's units' ratings.
"Nothing is trading too far off closing," a dealer said.
E.W. Scripps did not trade at all after hours, despite a company prediction that revenues might rise 10 percent.
Billing Concepts Corp also did not trade after hours following its warning that it would post $17.5 million of charges against earnings after the acquisition of Computer Resources Management Inc.
The New York Stock exchange said that session one volume reached 230,000 from 53,000 on Friday, and session two volume jumped to 3,888,360 from Friday's 491,300.
